verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a single line saying a Copilot-built agent can be tested, edited in Studio, and then scheduled and shared (skyvern-docs-29). That confirms some built-in scheduling but says nothing about recurrence, cadence, or how schedules are managed. The Zapier connection is an external integration and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring/cron-style schedule configuration, schedule management via API/SDK/MCP, scope (workflows vs. tasks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
